title: Natural Collocations
context: Native speakers say 'make a decision' and 'take a risk', not 'do a decision' or 'make a risk'. Learn the word partners together, as one piece, and your English sounds natural at once.
contextPersian: انگلیسی‌زبان‌ها می‌گویند make a decision و take a risk، نه do a decision یا make a risk. هم‌نشین‌ها را با هم و یک‌جا یاد بگیر تا انگلیسی‌ات یک‌دفعه طبیعی شود.

expressions.example: We need to make a decision by Friday.
expressions.note: Not "take a decision" in American English.

expressions.example: You have to take a risk if you want to grow.

expressions.examplePersian: بعد از مذاکرات طولانی، دو طرف به توافق رسیدند.

speakingTask.instruction: Use three collocations in a short description of your week.
speakingTask.instructionPersian: سه هم‌نشین را در یک توصیف کوتاه از هفته‌ات به کار ببر.
modelSentences: This week I have a tight schedule.
We are making good progress on the project.
We need to make a decision and meet the deadline.
The heavy traffic does not help!

roleplay.objective: Talk about a busy week using natural collocations
roleplay.context: A colleague asks how your week is going. Describe the project, your schedule, a decision you need to make and one problem. Try to use natural word partners such as make a decision, meet a deadline and heavy traffic.
roleplay.opening: Hi! How's your week going? You look busy.
